channel.title: Impartial Examiner on Anti-Federalist Library
channel.description: Recent content in Impartial Examiner on Anti-Federalist Library

item.title: Impartial Examiner I
item.description: Warns that the Constitution’s supremacy clause would destroy state sovereignty and create a dangerously powerful federal government without protecting individual rights.

item.title: Impartial Examiner II
item.description: Argues that the Constitution’s taxation powers would create interstate conflicts while its excise, military, and judicial provisions would destroy traditional liberties.

item.title: Impartial Examiner III
item.description: Concludes that the Constitution lacks individual rights protections and would create unlimited federal power that could destroy American liberty.

item.title: Impartial Examiner IV
item.description: Argues that the executive veto power appropriate for British monarchy is incompatible with American republican principles of equal liberty.

item.title: Impartial Examiner V
item.description: Examines whether constitutional change is necessary, noting agreement on strengthening federal commerce and taxation powers but disagreement over whether the proposed system sacrifices too much liberty.
